title: 第23章 下跪求饶第24章 突破锻骨
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
唐杰本来就被开门声吓了一跳，接着又看见林潜端着药，朝他缓缓逼近，露出一副厉鬼索命般的表情，让他毛骨悚然，瞬间崩溃。
“扑通。”
只见唐杰双膝跪地，带着哭腔对着林潜求饶说道：“林潜师弟，求你放过我，我不是故意针对你的，而是那内门弟子高文俊找到我，请我出手教训你一顿，让你在床上躺几个月。”
“是我鬼迷心窍，他还给了我十两银子，并说事成之后会再给我十两银子。”
说完，唐杰用他那还能动的左手狂扇自己大嘴巴，以求得林潜的原谅。
林潜被唐杰这一操作惊呆了。
“我有这么可怕嘛。”
他摸了摸自己的脸。
林潜只是遵循陈医师教导，对待病人要面带微笑，慢声细语，这样有助于缓解病人的压力。
所以他推门之前，专门做好了表情管理，才进来的，没想到还有意外之喜。
“嗯？内门弟子高文俊？”
林潜在脑海里过了一遍，完全没有关于自己与高文俊有什么交集。
“哦？那他有说为什么要给我一个教训吗？”
林潜站在唐杰面前，而唐杰跪在林潜面前，虽然林潜微笑客气的询问着，可这么一看，也有了一种居高临下的意味了。
“他...他...他说你顶撞了他，让我出手给你一个深刻教训。”
“还说你才突破到练皮，只要我出手，对付你，轻而易举，手到擒来。”
“我看还有这么多钱拿，我...我就答...答应了。”
唐杰说到后面声音越发的小了，眼睛不敢看林潜。
唐杰已经不想信守对高文俊的承诺了。
并且他心里已经恨死了高文俊，高文俊对他隐瞒林潜身份也就算了，还对他谎报林潜的武道境界。

要是知道林潜的真实境界他一定不会答应高文俊的要求。
“唐师兄别这样，来，你先起来。”
听完唐杰的话，林潜左手端药，右手扶起唐杰坐在椅子上。
“唐师兄，我们说开了就好，我不会放心上的，你放心。”
林潜一脸真诚的向着唐杰保证道。
听到唐杰的回复，林潜知道他只是充当一个打手的角色，被别人利用了罢了。
“你知道这高文俊是什么人吗？”
林潜话锋一转，向唐杰打听高文俊的背景。
林潜平时两点一线，不怎么社交，对宗门里的大部分弟子都不了解。
“这高文俊是蓬安城高家的二公子，进入宗门直接就是内门弟子。”
“就是那个很有钱的高家？”
“是的，林师兄。
并且他在苍云门修炼了四五年，已经是锻骨境界了。”
唐杰眼睛小心的看着林潜。
高家，林潜是知道的。
在他还是乞丐时，就听周围人讲过高家，不仅城外有大批良田，城里的很多店铺也都是高家的，高家靠收租都能收一大笔钱。
“哦，明白了，唐师兄。
content_en:
Tang Jie was startled by the sound of opening the door, and then he saw Lin Qian holding medicine and slowly approaching him, with an expression like a ghost threatening his life, which made his hair stand on end and he collapsed instantly.
"Plop."
Tang Jie was seen kneeling on his knees, crying and begging Lin Qian for mercy: "Junior brother Lin Qian, please let me go. I didn't target you on purpose. It was the inner disciple Gao Wenjun who found me and asked me to teach you a lesson and make you lie in bed for a few months."
"It was me who was obsessed with it. He gave me ten taels of silver and said he would give me another ten taels of silver when the matter was completed."
After saying that, Tang Jie used his still movable left hand to slap his mouth wildly, in order to ask for Lin Qian's forgiveness.
Lin Qian was stunned by Tang Jie's action.
"Am I so scary?"
He touched his face.
Lin Qian just followed Dr. Chen's teachings to treat patients with a smile and speak slowly, which would help relieve the patient's stress.
So before he opened the door, he specially managed his expression and came in. Unexpectedly, there was an unexpected surprise.
"Huh? Inner disciple Gao Wenjun?"
Lin Qian went through it in his mind, and there was no connection between him and Gao Wenjun at all.
"Oh? Then did he say why he wanted to teach me a lesson?"
Lin Qian stood in front of Tang Jie, and Tang Jie knelt in front of Lin Qian. Although Lin Qian smiled and asked politely, it seemed condescending.
"He...he...he said you contradicted him and asked me to teach you a profound lesson."
"You also said that you just broke through to skin training. As long as I take action, it will be easy to deal with you. I can capture you with my hands."
"I saw that there was still so much money to take, so I...I said...I agreed."
Tang Jie's voice became quieter as he spoke, and he didn't dare to look at Lin Qian.
Tang Jie no longer wants to keep his promise to Gao Wenjun.
And he already hated Gao Wenjun in his heart. Gao Wenjun concealed Lin Qian's identity from him, and even lied to him about Lin Qian's martial arts level.
If he knew Lin Qian's true state, he would definitely not agree to Gao Wenjun's request.
"Senior Brother Tang, don't be like this. Come on, get up first."
After listening to Tang Jie's words, Lin Qian held the medicine with his left hand and helped Tang Jie sit on the chair with his right hand.
"Senior Brother Tang, just let's get started. I won't worry about it, don't worry."
Lin Qian assured Tang Jie sincerely.
After hearing Tang Jie's reply, Lin Qian knew that he was just acting as a thug and was being used by others.
"Do you know who Gao Wenjun is?"
Lin Qian changed the subject and asked Tang Jie about Gao Wenjun's background.
Lin Qian usually works two hours a day, doesn't socialize much, and doesn't know most of the disciples in the sect.
"This Gao Wenjun is the second son of the Gao family in Peng'an City. He becomes an inner disciple immediately after entering the sect."
"Is it the very rich Gao family?"
"Yes, Senior Brother Lin.
Moreover, he has been practicing in Cangyun Sect for four or five years, and has already reached the realm of bone forging. "
Tang Jie looked at Lin Qian carefully.
Lin Qian knew about the Gao family.
When he was still a beggar, he heard people around him talk about the Gao family. Not only did they have a lot of fertile farmland outside the city, but many shops in the city also belonged to the Gao family. The Gao family could make a lot of money by collecting rent.
"Oh, I understand, Senior Brother Tang.
